messages:
dmitri: FYI — canary for q4b-int8 spiked failures on our paraphrase/near-dup checks after tokenizer v2 rollout. ~3% of canary prompts that used to pass are now flagged as different clusters :eyes:
caroline: ugh, any concrete examples? quick diff would help.
dmitri: two pairs: 
- "How do I reset my password?" vs "Password reset steps?" used to be same cluster, now split.
- "Schedule meeting tomorrow 3pm" vs "Set up a meeting for 3pm tomorrow" similarly split.
Repro snippet (run on canary):
```bash
python eval_harness.py --model q4b-int8 --tokenizer v2 --prompts sample_canary.jsonl --out canary_v2.jsonl
jq '.[] | {id,cluster_id,token_count}' canary_v2.jsonl | head
```
ben: Do we know if this is purely tokenization differences or if quantization interacts (KV cache offsets?)
dmitri: looks like tokenization. token counts differ by small amounts, which cascades into different hash for our cluster fingerprint. quant only surfaced because canary uses q4b-int8; but same effect seen on fp16 run too.
fran: ok — two quick ops: 1) create a small relabel batch with the split pairs (high precision pairs flagged), 2) run a parallel canary with tokenizer v1/v2 diff metric so we can measure drift by cluster recall.
alexa: I'll update the eval harness to emit per-pair tokenized forms and fingerprint seed. Patch I plan: add --emit-tokenized flag and produce a compact csv with columns: id,orig,tok_v1,tok_v2,cluster_v1,cluster_v2
should help triage automatically.
labeler-bot: New manual review batch created: review_queue/4401234567-paraphrase-tokenizer-v2 (26 items) — assigned to @labelers. Use rubric: keep_if_paraphrase / split_if_not.
caroline: For immediate mitigation, can we relax fingerprint similarity threshold from 0.85 -> 0.82 for the canary run? That would reduce false splits while we sort labeling.
ben: I'd avoid permanent threshold change; do it as temporary canary override and log metric delta. Also let's capture examples where a single token shift causes cluster change.
dmitri: agreed. I'll run canary with override and the diff harness:
```yaml
overrides:
  dedupe_similarity: 0.82
  emit_tokenized: true
```
and post results by EOD.
fran: I'll queue the 26 items to the relabelers and tag high-impact ones (freq>100 in production) for expedited review.
alexa: PR ready: https://git.internal/r/eval-harness/+/tokenizer-diff — includes a small parser to collapse token sequences and compute jaccard/token-level ngram overlap. Will link test results after CI.
dmitri: plan for tomorrow: 1) relabel batch results in morning, 2) canary rerun with override and v1/v2 diff, 3) follow-up meeting if >1.5% regression remains. anyone against? :thumbsup:
caroline: +1
ben: +1
fran: +1
labeler-bot: review batch progress: 4/26 completed, 2 flagged for escalation.
dmitri: thanks — filing a quick incident note in #incidents if we cross the threshold. I'll post the canary artifact link when done.
